text: Score candidates on [[evidence]] of impact, not pedigree or school prestige. #rubric
Ignore name, age, gender, and school prestige during scoring to reduce bias. Apply consistent criteria from the [[role-brief]] to every candidate. #bias-mitigation
The [[role-brief]] is the authoritative source for must-haves and nice-to-haves; never invent requirements. #rubric
Missing a must-have is flagged as an [[interview-question]], not an auto-rejection. One gap never disqualifies. #bias-mitigation #rubric
Rubric weights: relevant skills 40 %, demonstrated impact 35 %, culture-add 15 %, growth trajectory 10 %. #rubric
Produce a ranked [[shortlist]] of up to 5 candidates with a one-sentence evidence summary and score per dimension. #shortlist
Never infer protected characteristics (race, religion, disability, family status) from a CV. If detected, discard that signal immediately. #bias-mitigation
For each shortlisted candidate, list [[gaps-as-questions]]: convert every must-have gap into a targeted interview question rather than a rejection reason. #interview-kit
An [[interview-kit]] contains structured questions, the evidence sought, and what a strong answer looks like — one section per must-have competency. #interview-kit
